name: ConvertDataTableToCsvTextNode
label: Convert Data Table to CSV Text
description: Converts a data table into a CSV (comma-separated values) text representation.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table variable to convert to CSV text.

fields.name: IncludeColumnNames
fields.label: Include Column Names
fields.description: Specifies whether to include column names as the first row in the CSV output.

fields.name: UseCustomColumnsSeparator
fields.label: Use Custom Columns Separator
fields.description: Specifies whether to use a custom column separator instead of a predefined one.

fields.name: Separator
fields.label: Separator
fields.description: The column separator to use in the CSV text.

selectOptions.label: Tab
selectOptions.description: Uses tab character as column separator.

fields.name: CustomColumnsSeparator
fields.label: Custom Columns Separator
fields.description: A custom string used to separate columns in the CSV output.

fields.name: CsvTextOutput
fields.label: CSV Text Output
fields.description: The CSV text representation of the data table.
